breakdown.description: Output requests solution at T=1.1 but the Domain section specifies t in [0, 1].
breakdown.reason: The agent failed to resolve the inconsistency. The ground truth corrects the final time to T=1.0 to match the specified time domain t in [0, 1.0]. The agent, however, noted the conflict but then proceeded to use the incorrect final time T=1.1 throughout the specification, thereby repeating the user's error.
